acceptance.given: A requested target package path is missing, escapes the repository, or resolves to a non-directory target.

oracle.expected: The Toolchain replay validator rejects the target before reporting a successful validation or replay result.
forbidden: A successful validation receipt for the illegal target
Invocation of the capability validator after the target has been rejected as absent or escaping
oracle.observable: The process returns nonzero and the existing skill-package replay test observes the target-rejection error.

acceptance.then: The illegal target is rejected without a successful result.
acceptance.when: A Toolchain target-evaluation request supplies an illegal target.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the existing skill-package replay target tests with an absent or repository-escaping target and require a nonzero rejection before validator execution.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Bind Toolchain target evaluation to repository containment and directory validity so missing, escaping, or non-directory targets fail before validator execution.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted schema or state changes; restore the prior target-validation implementation if the bounded rejection behavior must be rolled back.

slice_hint.state_transition: Target-evaluation request with an illegal target -> rejected non-success result.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: An illegal target cannot produce a successful validation or replay receipt and cannot reach capability-validator execution.

acceptance.given: S10 has a declared execution context but its required real test file has not yet been authored and executed.

oracle.expected: Quick Dev authors scripts/sc/tests/tc_d1_cer/test_s10.py under the owning Toolchain slice and its assertions execute successfully before S10 is frozen or probed.
forbidden: Freezing or probing S10 before the S10 selector has executed its real assertions
Treating the planned-test declaration, CLI help, schema, capability descriptor, or prior receipt as S10 execution evidence
oracle.observable: The exact pytest selector executes scripts/sc/tests/tc_d1_cer/test_s10.py and its result is available before the S10 freeze-and-probe step.

acceptance.then: S10 has real, executed test evidence before freeze and probe.
acceptance.when: Quick Dev is about to freeze and probe S10.

failure_intents.selector_intent: The S10 authoring guard fails when freezing or probing is attempted without a successful execution of the exact S10 pytest selector.

affected_subjects: S10 real test authoring and execution
slice_hint.behavior_change: Author and execute the exact S10 pytest test under the Toolchain owning slice; require that execution as pre-freeze and pre-probe evidence for the S10 detached-probe behavior.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted schema or state changes; remove the S10 pre-freeze execution enforcement only by restoring the prior Toolchain implementation and deleting the authored test through a separately authorized change.

slice_hint.state_transition: S10 planned execution context -> exact S10 test authored and executed -> S10 eligible for freeze and probe.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: S10 cannot be frozen or probed until scripts/sc/tests/tc_d1_cer/test_s10.py exists and the exact pytest selector has executed its real assertions.

acceptance.given: A pre-repair tracked-worktree membership and byte identity have been captured for the repository.

oracle.expected: The before and after snapshots retain identical tracked membership; a changed tracked file set or tracked content identity is not considered the same snapshot.
forbidden: Changing historical tracked membership during repair
Accepting a same-head or same-status comparison when tracked bytes or tracked membership have drifted
oracle.observable: The existing Git snapshot tests compare versioned content identities and report mismatch for tracked, staged, or untracked membership/content drift.

acceptance.when: FR-5 Toolchain repair work is evaluated against its pre-repair snapshot.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Exercise the Git content-identity comparison with tracked membership or byte drift and require the comparison to reject it.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Preserve historical tracked membership by using complete content identities that include tracked-worktree membership and bytes, and reject comparisons with identity drift.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted schema or state changes; restore the prior snapshot-comparison implementation if the bounded integrity check must be rolled back.

slice_hint.state_transition: Pre-repair historical tracked membership -> post-repair identity comparison -> unchanged membership accepted or drift rejected.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Historical tracked membership and tracked bytes compare identically before and after repair; any membership or content drift fails the comparison.

acceptance.given: A frozen execution snapshot is assembled from its explicitly declared runtime roots.

oracle.expected: The snapshot boundary excludes Toolchain production-owner files from frozen test snapshots while retaining only the declared snapshot roots and rejecting unlisted semantic/runtime files.
forbidden: Including a production owner file in a frozen test snapshot
Silently accepting an unlisted semantic or runtime file outside the declared snapshot roots
oracle.observable: The existing runtime-snapshot exclusion tests inspect the resolved snapshot roots and verify that excluded or unlisted paths are handled according to the snapshot boundary.

acceptance.then: Frozen test snapshots exclude production owner files.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Construct a snapshot request that places a production-owner path in the frozen test-snapshot set and require boundary validation to reject it.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce the frozen-test-snapshot ownership boundary in the Toolchain snapshot resolver so production-owner files are excluded and only declared snapshot roots are eligible.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted schema or state changes; restore the prior snapshot-root resolution implementation if this boundary enforcement must be rolled back.

slice_hint.state_transition: Snapshot roots with a production-owner candidate -> ownership-boundary validation -> production owner excluded from frozen test snapshot.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: No production owner file appears in the frozen test snapshot, and unlisted semantic/runtime paths fail closed rather than entering the snapshot.
